C0181.title: Student sued for negative review sparks debate on boundary between fair criticism and defamation
C0181.summary: In January 2022, a graduate student in Beijing posted comments on Zhihu about a liberal arts postgraduate exam prep service, using phrases like 'covetously eyeing' and 'cyber-mobbed'. The company, Guangxi Wenkao Education Consulting Co., Ltd., sued for defamation. The court ruled the language constituted insult or slander, ordering compensation and a public apology.
